title: Predators that grow on the prey material they digest and divide by their own growth, while condensing only up their digestion product
summary: Open problem (1) of the ecology line: in c52/c60's world the predator material is conserved, so a predator can only divide by being torn between sister prey. I change that one thing: digested prey material becomes predator material (yield yb, the rest to waste) and predator material decays to waste, while the predator still condenses only up its own digestion product q (so the L4c kd=0 arm stays a dynamical test). Measure division sites by prey contact, free share, hops, the predator-free twin for X and the kd=0 arm. Also a negative screen: prey-material turnover (decay inside, remade outside) on c60's prey arrests into a hexagonal microphase (no sustained prey division) at kda 0.0003-0.05.
